title: Anna and Her Trips
text:
Anna lives in a small town. Every day she takes the bus to school. The bus is yellow and it is very big. The bus stop is near her house.

On Saturday, Anna goes to the city by train. The train is fast. It takes one hour. She likes to look out of the window.

questions.text: How long does the train take?
Why does Anna probably take the bus every day?
options: She needs to go to school

questions.text: How does Anna probably feel about the train?

vocabulary.definition: a large vehicle that carries many people
a long vehicle that moves on rails and carries people
a glass opening in a wall where you can look outside

paragraph_translations: Anna mora em uma cidade pequena. Todo dia ela pega o ônibus para ir à escola. O ônibus é amarelo e é muito grande. O ponto de ônibus fica perto da casa dela.
No sábado, Anna vai à cidade de trem. O trem é rápido. Ele leva uma hora. Ela gosta de olhar pela janela.
